originals.why: Natural North Welsh. It uses wnaethon nhw adael in the same 'they left' sense, and 'ond … ar ddiwrnod cyntaf y flwyddyn newydd' sits well in this seed's 'ond …' frame.

나는 그들이 왜 각자 혼자 떠났는지 물어봤어
